items.description:
Dr Sven Strydom is a specialist orthopaedic surgeon practising at Life Eugene Marais Hospital in Les Marais, Pretoria, treating disorders of the musculoskeletal system. His practice covers adult and paediatric trauma and limb reconstruction, hip and knee replacements, and large joint arthroscopy, alongside a particular focus on hand surgery.

For hand procedures, the practice uses the WALANT technique, wide-awake local anaesthesia without a tourniquet, which lets patients remain conscious and avoids some of the risks associated with general anaesthesia or a tourniquet during surgery. The practice is based in the Cardio Building at Life Eugene Marais Hospital, and it is open on weekdays from 8am to 5pm, with no consultations over the weekend.

DSV Accounting is a professional accounting firm based in Doringkloof, Centurion, offering financial statement preparation, bookkeeping, tax advisory and returns filing, and estate and trust planning. Its client base ranges from small businesses to larger organisations and individuals across different sectors of the economy.

The firm's team draws on more than 15 years in the financial sector individually and a combined total of more than 25 years across the financial and customer service fields, and it says it invests in ongoing staff development to keep pace with changes in the financial sector. DSV positions its service around building long-term relationships with clients, taking the time to understand the specific challenges facing each business or individual it works with.

E & I Metal Pressing cc is a metal engineering company based in Booysens, Pretoria, founded in 1995. The business produces small to medium-size metal pressings for various industries, alongside metal forming, welding of non-ferrous metals such as aluminium and stainless steel, and precision metal cutting.

Its pipe bending service covers press, rotary draw and roll bending methods, letting it handle different pipe diameters and bend profiles for different jobs, and it also installs and maintains aluminium products on site. The company describes quality and attention to detail as central to its work, reflecting the precision needed when pressing and bending metal components to exact specifications for industrial clients.

EEC, trading as Effectual Energy Consultants, is an engineering firm based in Centurion specialising in renewable energy, power security and business continuity, alongside energy efficiency and smart automation work. It designs bespoke residential solar and backup power systems using European components, as well as customised commercial power systems for business clients.

The firm says it draws on in-house engineering expertise to make electricity more cost-effective, reliable and available on a client's own terms rather than a utility's schedule, and its client list includes Security Warehouse, Centurion Golf Estate, Southern Implants and Carbon International. EEC's office is open on weekdays from 8am to 5pm for consultations, project feasibility assessments and new installation enquiries.

Elephant Lifting Equipment is a Southern African supplier, designer and manufacturer of industrial lifting equipment, established in 1982 and based in Rooihuiskraal, Centurion. Its product range covers electric and manual chain hoists, wire rope hoists, slings, rigging accessories and jib cranes for lifting and material-handling applications.

Beyond selling equipment, the company offers service, repair, proof load testing and certification, helping clients keep lifting gear compliant and safe to use over its working life rather than simply replacing it when it fails. More than four decades in the lifting equipment industry has given the business an established base of product knowledge across the hoists, cranes and rigging accessories it supplies to industrial customers.

Elite Clearing and Forwarding is a SARS AEO-accredited freight forwarding and customs clearance company established in 2006, based in Clubview, Centurion. The business handles air and sea cargo imports and exports, including specialised categories such as firearms and ammunition, electronics, mining machinery and motor vehicles.

Its AEO accreditation signals a recognised level of compliance and security in its customs processes, which can speed up clearance for the specialised and high-value cargo it handles. Alongside its Centurion base, the company operates offices in Cape Town and Durban, giving it a presence at South Africa's major port cities for clients moving goods in and out of the country by sea as well as air.

KOST Quotation Software develops a quotation and invoicing application aimed at service businesses, helping them manage jobs and get paid faster. Users can create quotes from templates with preloaded material pricing, work on a quotation while on site, and send both quotes and invoices through WhatsApp rather than relying only on email.

The software also supports a request-for-quote workflow, letting a business ask a supplier for current pricing and have the response flow back into the system automatically, and it integrates with Sage, QuickBooks and Xero so that invoices and payment statuses stay in sync with a client's existing bookkeeping. Beyond maintenance jobs, KOST also handles larger construction tenders, and its support line is available on weekdays from 8am to 5pm.

Kristal Auctions is one of the largest auction houses in Gauteng, based in Andeon, Pretoria, and holds weekly auctions at its own venue alongside onsite sales held nationwide. The business sells movable assets ranging from household and storage contents to leisure, business, farming and construction equipment.

It also runs its own auction academy, training newcomers to the industry and introducing them to the auctioneering profession rather than leaving new talent to learn only on the job. Over the years, Kristal Auctions has built a reputation among business owners and private individuals, both buyers and sellers, as a reliable auction partner, and it continues to expand its weekly Andeon auctions alongside its nationwide onsite sales programme.

LM in the East is one of Pretoria's oldest Portuguese family restaurants, trading from Lynnwood Galleries on the corner of Rosemary and Diana Streets. It carries the LM Prawns name, a Portuguese seafood brand with roots in Pretoria West and Johannesburg Central dating back to the mid-1980s, and the menu reflects that heritage with prawns, calamari and prego rolls alongside pizza and steak.

The Lynnwood branch is one of a small number of LM locations, giving it the backing of an established brand while still operating as a neighbourhood restaurant in its own Lynnwood Galleries premises. It trades daily from 10am to 10pm, making it a regular lunch and dinner option for the surrounding Lynnwood area.

Marebole Security Solutions is a 100% Black-owned security services company based in Lyttelton Manor, Centurion, incorporated in 2009 and registered with PSIRA. Its guarding services division trains qualified security personnel to perform a range of functions as part of a broader bouquet of protection services for homes, estates, malls, schools and businesses.

The company's technical division installs advanced security systems including CCTV, alarm systems, access control and gate automation, while its close protection and VIP protection sections cover secure mobility and discreet protection for high-profile individuals. Marebole is also certified as a National Key Point service provider, a designation reserved for firms able to protect sites of strategic national importance.

Mbozisi Construction & Architect is a Philip Nel Park-based building and design business offering end-to-end services, from residential and commercial construction and renovations through to architectural design and municipal plan submissions. Its geotechnical offering includes DCP soil testing and foundation design, giving it the groundwork expertise to support its own building projects.

The company also handles civil site work, plant hire, building material supply and swimming pool construction, covering most of what a client needs to take a project from an idea to a finished site. It serves Pretoria, Centurion, Midrand, Johannesburg and the wider Gauteng and Mpumalanga area, positioning itself as a single point of contact for clients who would otherwise have to coordinate separate architects, engineers and contractors themselves.

MC van der Berg Attorneys Inc is a property law firm that grew from a small practice founded in Sunnyside in 1999 into offices across Centurion, Pretoria East and Midstream, including this Eldoraigne office. The firm specialises in conveyancing, bond registration and property transfers, handling the legal side of buying, selling and financing property.

Beyond transfers, the practice drafts wills and testaments, administers deceased estates and handles sectional title registration, covering much of the legal work that follows a property through its life, from a first purchase to a later estate transfer. Its growth from a single Sunnyside office to multiple branches across the greater Pretoria area reflects a practice that has stayed focused on property law while expanding its geographic reach.

Med-Step Clinic is a sub-acute rehabilitation facility in Eloffsdal, Pretoria, operating since 2009 as one of the original sub-acute facilities in the area. It was the first sub-acute facility licensed to care for ventilated patients, and over the years it has refined its rehabilitation protocols in line with international standards and modalities.

The clinic offers 24 single rooms and 3 double rooms fitted with DSTV, air conditioning, wall oxygen and suction, and its multi-disciplinary team provides neurological, orthopaedic, cardiovascular, respiratory, restorative and palliative rehabilitation for patients moving from hospital back to home. Med-Step has partnered with all medical aids and is one of a limited number of Gauteng facilities taking part in Discovery Health's Care Coordination Programme.

Melanie Peyper is a Centurion optometry practice that was established in 2010 as Irene Village Mall Optometrists before adopting its current name five years later. Based in Pierre van Ryneveld Park, the practice offers eye tests, frames and contact lenses, supported by equipment including a fundus camera and a corneal topographer for more detailed eye examinations.

The practice has built up specialised fitting experience for scleral lenses and keratoconus, as well as multifocal correction and sports vision, areas that go beyond a standard eye test and frame fitting. That combination of diagnostic equipment and specialised lens-fitting experience positions the practice for patients with more complex vision needs, alongside its everyday frames and contact lens customers.

Mentornet is a private college in Wierdapark, Centurion, accredited by the ETDP SETA, that has specialised in education, training and development since 1991. In 2002 it became the first private college accredited for a full qualification by the ETDP SETA and the QCTO, a status it has maintained for more than two decades.

Its SAQA-aligned programme now spans more than 100 short courses alongside occupational qualifications from NQF Level 4 through to Level 7, covering roles such as facilitator, assessor, moderator and skills development facilitator. Classroom sessions are held monthly at its Centurion campus, and the college reports more than 10,000 graduates certified over its history, with a 4.7 student rating reflecting its long track record in the ETD training field.

MLS Gauteng North is a non-profit multiple listing service bringing together more than 50 real estate agencies across Pretoria North and the greater northeast, including Dorandia, Montana, Annlin and Akasia. Rather than competing separately for the same buyers, member agencies share their property stock through MLS Gauteng North as a combined team.

The organisation runs tools including a bond calculator and a property finder for buyers and tenants, alongside property email alerts and a listing service for sellers who want their property seen by all member agencies at once. That shared-stock model means a buyer working with any one member agency can effectively search listings from more than 50 agencies through a single relationship, rather than approaching each agency separately.

Moore Pretoria, established in 1984 and based in Lynnwood, Pretoria, is an accounting, audit and tax consulting firm with around 50 staff serving clients across Pretoria and Johannesburg. It is the local member of the Moore Global network, which groups more than 30,000 staff in 112 countries under one international accounting brand.

Through that network, the practice offers services spanning accounting, audit and assurance, tax advisory and compliance, corporate finance, valuations, due diligence, and governance, risk and internal audit work, drawing on international Moore methodology while keeping its own Pretoria-based team and client relationships. That combination of a long-established local partnership with international network backing gives clients access to specialist skills a smaller standalone firm might not carry in-house.

MRJ Consultants, trading as Genesis Retail Software, is a Centurion-based software developer founded in 1996 and reimagined in 2014, now running an in-house team of 35 professionals. Its Genesis point-of-sale and ERP system covers the retail sector from stock control through to the general ledger, with seamless data migration from legacy systems and built-in WooCommerce e-commerce integration.

Genesis includes offline trading capability, letting retailers keep selling through load-shedding, along with advanced auto-ordering to prevent stock-outs and support for detailed job cards and budgeting. The company backs its software with a dedicated in-house support team rather than a call centre, and its Nexus platform connects managed IT services, remote support and infrastructure monitoring into the same Microsoft Azure-powered ecosystem as the Genesis software itself.

Olympic Catering Equipment has manufactured and supplied catering, refrigeration and kitchen equipment since 1971, running a stainless steel fabrication facility and a refrigeration manufacturing plant from its Pretoria West premises. The site also houses a repairs department and separate showrooms for new and secondhand equipment, stocking brands including Bravilor, Scotsman, Manitowoc, Robot Coupe and Electrolux.

Equipment manufactured and supplied by the company carries a full 12-month guarantee, and Olympic Catering Equipment keeps spare parts in stock for the equipment it sells, with its own factory able to fabricate specialised items to order. It also offers free kitchen and store design consultations to prospective hospitality clients, and the Pretoria West showroom is open Monday to Thursday from 8am to 5pm, Fridays until 4:30pm, and Saturdays from 9am to 1pm.

Plug & Play Solutions is a security and surveillance company based in Lyttelton Manor, Centurion, with more than 20 years of experience in surveillance, monitoring and access-control technology. It builds AI-driven CCTV installation, integrated access control and remote monitoring systems, designing bespoke setups for each site rather than a single standard package.

The company reports protecting more than 13,500 sites and serving over 600 clients across retail, finance, mining, aviation and government, covering shrinkage control, robbery prevention and burglary protection alongside its core surveillance work. Its custom-built security infrastructure, including biometric access systems, is engineered by in-house specialists who assess each client's specific risks before designing a system, rather than installing the same setup at every site.

Qbis Software is a software development company based in The Willows, Pretoria, founded in 2000, with a team of between 11 and 50 employees. It builds business management systems spanning CRM, ERP and business intelligence reporting, offered as a single software solution rather than separate tools for each business function.

The system covers integrated projects, billing, sales and marketing, reporting and collaboration, with a flexible, customisable design that adapts to different industries including manufacturing, high-tech, retail and real estate. Its personalised CRM lets businesses modify screen and print layouts, menu systems, dropdown options and the user interface, and remote teams can securely access the same data from Windows, Mac, iOS, Android or Windows Phone devices.

QEDO Pretoria operates from Centurion as an Acumatica cloud ERP partner, tracing its roots to a company called eNovate Solutions established in 2001 before it became QEDO Modern Cloud, part of the wider QEDO Group. Its founders moved into IT from an accounting background after automating cross-casting through spreadsheets sparked more interest than the accounting profession itself.

QEDO delivers industry software solutions that combine financial management with integrated CRM, distribution, manufacturing, field service and project accounting modules, built on cloud Enterprise Resource Planning technology. In 2024 the business was acquired by IT services and advisory firm APPSolve, a move aimed at strengthening its Acumatica offering, while QEDO continues to apply its accounting background to digital transformation projects across general business, distribution, manufacturing, services and construction sectors.

Register Your Business handles company and tax registrations with CIPC, SARS and the Department of Labour from its Centurion office, covering Pty Ltd, Inc, NPC and co-operative registration alongside VAT, PAYE and UIF registration. Its secretarial services include annual returns, company name reservations, and close corporation or company amendments and restorations.

The business also applies for BEE EME certificates, CIDB registration, import and export licences, and letters of good standing on behalf of clients, extending its work beyond initial registration into the ongoing compliance a business needs to keep trading. A standard company registration typically takes five to seven working days, and the office is open Monday to Thursday from 9am to 4pm and Fridays from 9am to noon.

Reliance Laboratory Equipment supplies testing equipment for the construction and civil engineering sectors from its base in Klerksoord, Akasia, manufactured to SANS specifications with SANAS calibration services. The family-owned business was established in 1947 and is now in its third generation of family ownership, with more than 77 years in the industry.

Its product categories cover soil, asphalt and bitumen, concrete and cement, coring and sampling, and particle size analysis, alongside general laboratory equipment, supplying tools for on-site and laboratory tests on aggregates, rock, soil, cement, concrete, mortar and steel. The company supplies customers nationwide from its Pretoria base, and it says that despite decades of growth, its core values as a family business have not changed.

SA Fire Holdings, trading as SA Fire Group, supplies and services certified fire equipment from its premises on Steve Biko Road, Wonderboom South, with more than 20 years of experience in the fire and safety industry. Its core offering covers extinguishers, hose reels and hydrants serviced to SANS 1475 standards, including pressure testing and refills carried out by its own technicians.

Beyond equipment supply and servicing, the company installs smoke and heat detection systems and supplies field firefighting equipment, and it runs fire safety and first-aid training courses for client staff. SA Fire Holdings positions its SABS-approved equipment and SANS 1475-certified maintenance as a way for client premises to stay compliant and ready for an emergency rather than only passing an annual inspection.

Sigma Logistic Solutions is a logistics support business based in Waterkloof Glen, Pretoria, specialising in technical documentation with more than 30 years of experience in the defence and commercial sectors. It produces technical manuals and publications to the S1000D specification, a structured documentation standard widely used across military and commercial industries.

Its technical authoring and illustrating teams prepare content written to military and commercial specifications, while its support engineering division applies maintenance engineering and logistic support analysis to help clients reduce operating costs and downtime. Sigma also develops its own SIGMA-IDVS interactive maintenance management system, letting clients manage asset documentation and maintenance records through a single proprietary platform rather than generic office software.

This Waterkloof Glen office operates as a Built Environment Capacity Building partnership between the Association of Construction Project Managers and the Department of Public Works and Infrastructure, based in the Menlyn Maine Precinct. It delivers training and professional development aimed at building technical capacity within the built environment professions.

The Association of Construction Project Managers is accredited by the South African Council for Project and Construction Management Professions as a voluntary association, registered under number V/007/2005, and its training activities are validated by that council as part of members' Continuing Professional Development requirements. Through this partnership, the office runs accredited courses and resources that help built environment professionals meet their ongoing CPD obligations while building skills relevant to public infrastructure delivery.

Venter Consulting Engineers is a precision-engineering firm based in Lyttelton Manor, Centurion, organised around three engineering groups: turbo machinery, gear technology and general heavy-industrial engineering. Its turbo machinery group focuses on the design and manufacture of high-speed rotating equipment, including impeller and bladed disk manufacturing methods.

The gear technology group brings in-depth knowledge of the design, high-precision manufacturing and inspection of all gear types, while the general engineering group handles heavy industrial work and precision CNC manufacturing. Services across these groups include structural and vibration analysis, computational fluid dynamic analysis, and 3D CAD-to-part comparison for dimensional inspection, serving clients in the power generation, mining, aerospace and petrochemical industries.

WALLI 5 Star Enterprises is a diversified multi-service company based in Erasmia, Centurion, established in April 2016. It supplies IT and ICT solutions, interactive audio-visual systems and e-learning platforms alongside a separate range covering furniture, solar, gas and water systems, stationery and travel services, including Hajj and Umrah packages.

The business describes itself as available throughout the week to handle customer enquiries, supporting products from partners and manufacturers it considers reputable, and pricing its services without hidden charges. Alongside its Centurion headquarters, WALLI 5 Star Enterprises operates additional offices in Cape Town, Durban and Polokwane, giving it a presence in several of South Africa's major cities for its varied service offering.

Workshop@LPM Trading is a car service and repair workshop in Raslouw, Centurion, servicing all vehicle makes and models rather than specialising in particular brands. Its work covers air-conditioning repairs, auto electrical faults, battery sales and clutch work, alongside computerised diagnostics for tracking down less obvious mechanical and electronic problems.

The workshop also handles wheel alignment and balancing, diesel particulate filter servicing, and tow-bar fitment, giving it a broad enough range of services to cover most routine maintenance and repair needs in one visit. Workshop@LPM Trading backs this with 24/7 emergency call-outs for breakdowns outside its normal trading hours, which run Monday to Thursday from 7am to 5pm and Fridays from 7am to 3:30pm.

Aandklas is a rock-and-roll pub, restaurant and live-music venue on Hilda Street in Hatfield, operating since 2006 in a building that was previously the student hangout Up The Creek. The venue runs a themed weekly schedule, with Rock Thursdays, table-dancing Fridays, live bands on Saturdays and open-mic nights on Sundays.

Regulars describe an unpretentious, dingy-chic atmosphere built around old-school rock music, cheap drinks and a dance-on-the-tables culture that has carried through from its earlier days as Up The Creek, and reviewers also mention a regular Wednesday quiz night alongside the weekend live music. That mix of long-running theme nights and a loyal following has kept Aandklas a fixture of Hatfield's nightlife for close to two decades.

Ascor Independent Wealth Managers is a fee-based wealth management firm founded in 1998 and based at Persequor Techno Park, Pretoria. It was one of the first multi-disciplinary practices in South Africa to deliver financial, estate and investment planning alongside tax, auditing and accounting services under one roof.

The firm has been named Best Advisor Practice for South Africa by International Advisor magazine in both 2016 and 2018, and more recently received the FPI Professional Practice of the Year award, recognition it links to its commitment to ethical financial planning and client care. As an independent, fee-based practice, Ascor positions itself as working for its clients rather than selling products tied to a particular product provider.

Astore Keymak is a supplier of thermoplastic pipe fittings, valves, pipeline accessories and plastic welding equipment, with its Pretoria branch based in Waltloo. The business was built from the heritage of Astore Africa, a plastic pipe and fittings manufacturer, and Keymak, a flexible hose manufacturer, and now operates 10 branches across South Africa.

Its range includes Italian-manufactured Unidelta compression fittings, Italian PVC valves and fittings, and PVC pipe manufactured by Astore and FIP, alongside finished products such as electro-fusion fittings and polypropylene sheet from the Austrian manufacturer Agru. The company serves agriculture, mining, industrial, infrastructure and wholesale and retail customers, and it runs its own delivery fleet to reach customers directly.

Per the chain rule, that's not enough on its own.

Only national/group-level facts about AVBOB as a mutual society were confirmed (founded 1918, 188 funeral agencies and 132 insurance offices nationwide, no external shareholders). Nothing about this specific Pretoria Central/Madiba Street branch's own services, staff or operations was found beyond the branch finder; the research returned only the generic national homepage, so a description would be entirely group-level.

Aveng Trident Steel's Rosslyn branch is an automotive distribution and steel merchanting facility supplying original equipment and component manufacturers in the automotive just-in-time steel supply chain. The branch processes and warehouses more than a million tons of steel a year, including automotive blanks, special steel, structural plate, pipe and tube.

Operating as part of the wider Aveng Trident Steel network across Gauteng, the Rosslyn branch is positioned to support manufacturers that need steel delivered on tight production schedules rather than carrying large stockpiles themselves. That just-in-time model makes the branch's warehousing and processing capacity, rather than retail stock on a shelf, the main service it offers to the automotive manufacturers it supplies in and around Rosslyn.

Bakali Foodstuffs makes healthy rice and corn cake snacks from its base in Samrand Business Park, Centurion, with roots dating back to a sugar-waffle business started in the Democratic Republic of Congo in 1975 before the brand expanded into South Africa in the 1990s. Its cakes are gluten-free and low in fat, sodium, cholesterol and sugar, offering an alternative to traditional bread and heavier snacks.

The product range covers plain rice and corn cakes suited to diabetics watching their sugar intake, coated cakes as an alternative to chocolate bars, flavoured mini cakes aimed at families, and tortilla and popped chips in gourmet flavours. Bakali markets its snacks as suitable for most diets and for lunchbox use, and its Centurion office is open on weekdays from 8am to 5pm.

Battiss Guest House occupies a house on 20th Street in Menlo Park originally designed in 1939 by the architect Norman Eaton for the South African artist Walter Battiss. The house was rescued from demolition and renovated in the 1980s, with further renovations carried out in 2020, before it reopened as a guest house.

That architectural heritage, and the Battiss name it carries, sets the guest house apart from a standard Pretoria bed and breakfast, giving guests a stay inside a piece of design history alongside the usual comforts of a guest house. It operates today as a highly rated establishment in Menlo Park, marketed around the themes of tranquility, luxury and comfort that its renovation was built to deliver.

Bramland Group provides tree felling, stump grinding and tree care services across Pretoria and Gauteng, operating since 1992 with 24-hour call-outs. Its tree work covers pruning, site clearing, big tree transplanting and wood chipping, alongside dedicated irrigation and instant lawn services for gardens being replanted after tree removal.

The company runs its own nursery and sawmill, and sells firewood, charcoal and compost made from the trees it processes, turning removed timber into saleable products rather than simply disposing of it. Bramland also offers garden recovery, demolishing and earthworks services, giving it a broader scope than a typical tree-felling contractor and letting it handle a property's landscaping needs before and after a tree is removed.

Brother International South Africa is the local arm of the Brother technology brand, based at Route 21 Corporate Park in Irene, Pretoria. It manufactures and sells printers, including A3, colour laser, ink tank, mono laser and mobile Pocketjet and Ruggedjet printers, alongside label printers for business and personal use.

Beyond printing hardware, Brother South Africa sells sewing, quilting and embroidery machines and its ScanNCut cutting and crafting machines, and offers business solutions such as fleet management for monitoring printing devices from a central location. All Brother products sold in South Africa carry a free product warranty, either on-site or carry-in, with no registration required, and the company runs an anti-counterfeit awareness programme to help customers identify genuine Brother supplies.

Cafe Beyritz is a European bistro with a French slant at Lynnwood Bridge in Lynnwood Manor, offering separate breakfast, lunch and fine-dining dinner menus rather than a single all-day menu. Breakfast and lunch run toward dishes such as eggs Benedict and croque monsieur, while the dinner menu moves into more formal fare including roasted lamb and slow-roasted duck.

The restaurant backs its food with an extensive wine list, positioning itself for diners looking for a sit-down European meal rather than a quick casual lunch. Its Lynnwood Bridge location places it within the same retail and office development as the Atterbury Theatre, giving it a built-in audience of shoppers, office workers and theatregoers looking for a more considered meal before or after other errands.

items.description:
CXO Dynamic Business Solutions is an ICT consulting firm originally established under South African law as Performance Alignment Solutions in 2008, now trading as CXO Dynamic Business Solutions from Irene, Centurion. The firm organises its offering around four areas: skilled people, business solutions, technologies and consulting services, backed by its own CXO Academy training arm.

Its business solutions cover twelve integrated enterprise applications, including performance, product lifecycle, content, risk and quality management systems, aimed at specific business challenges rather than one-size-fits-all software. CXO Academy delivers industry-specific business and IT training informed by workplace skills plans, and the firm says its services have reached clients across more than nine industries in the southern African region, working from offices that include Pretoria and Cape Town alongside its Centurion base.

Dynamic Auctioneers is the auction division of Dynamic Solutions 1068 (Pty) Ltd, established in 2002 and based in Raslouw, Centurion, with more than 20 years of experience across residential, commercial and movable asset auctions. It runs auctions of vehicles, machinery, electronics, and commercial, industrial, agricultural and vacant-land property, alongside property management, valuations and inspections.

The business also handles asset disposal for insolvencies, liquidations, and deceased and divorced estates, areas where a transparent auction process can resolve a sale faster than a standard private listing. Alongside its core property and movable asset auctions, Dynamic Auctioneers runs a gemstone collection featuring certified sapphires, emeralds, rubies and tanzanite, each authenticated by independent gemologists, and the firm is accredited with the SA Institute of Auctioneers, EAAB, PPRA and the National Auction Association.

Eaglebyte is a managed IT services provider based in Villieria, Pretoria, operating since 2011 and recognised as a Microsoft Partner. Its core IT support covers PCs, laptops, servers, networks, UPS systems and IoT devices, backed by business-class email with 50GB synced mailboxes and cloud file storage for clients who want their data backed up off-site.

Endpoint protection runs on Malwarebytes-powered security software to guard against malware and ransomware, and the company also offers domain registration and web hosting for clients building an online presence. Beyond IT services, Eaglebyte installs Hikvision surveillance systems, access control, alarm systems and intercom systems, giving it a combined footprint across both IT infrastructure and physical security for the Pretoria businesses it serves.

ECIC is the Export Credit Insurance Corporation of South Africa, a state-owned national export credit agency established in 2001 under the Export Credit and Foreign Investments Insurance Act. Based in Highveld, Centurion, it provides political and commercial risk insurance to South African exporters of capital goods and related services, with a particular focus on Africa and other emerging markets.

Beyond export credit cover, ECIC offers investment insurance for South African entities investing in foreign countries, and a Small and Medium Transactions programme tailored to smaller exporters. As a self-sustained, licensed non-life insurer and authorised Financial Services Provider, ECIC also works in partnership with Afreximbank, extending its reach as an export risk partner for South African businesses trading into markets that commercial insurers may see as too risky to cover alone.

Ecoscape Landscape Construction is a landscaping and construction company serving Pretoria East and the wider Gauteng area, with more than 24 years of experience and over 700 completed garden projects. Its services span custom garden design and soft landscaping through to hardscaping, paving and retaining walls.

Beyond garden work, the company takes on structural building construction and outdoor entertainment areas, offering what it calls turnkey solutions, where a client hands over a brief and the company manages the project through to a finished, functional space. That combination of landscaping and construction services under one company lets Ecoscape take on both residential garden upgrades and larger commercial landscape and building projects without bringing in separate contractors for each trade.

Ergo Designer Kitchens & Cabinetry is a women-owned design studio and factory in Koedoespoort Industrial, Pretoria, with more than a decade in the cabinetry industry. The business designs, manufactures and installs kitchens, built-in cupboards, vanities and home offices, handling the full process from design through to installation rather than outsourcing manufacturing to a separate factory.

Ergo Designer Kitchens is a registered member of the Kitchen Specialists Association, the industry body for kitchen designers and manufacturers in South Africa, a membership that requires meeting the association's design and manufacturing standards. The business has also won design awards at the Homemakers Expo Pretoria, recognition that reflects its design work alongside its manufacturing and installation capability.

EZAIR Air Conditioning sells, installs, services and repairs air conditioners and heat pumps for residential and commercial customers, working with brands including Samsung, Midea, LG, Daikin and Alliance. The company operates from offices in Pretoria and Ballito, splitting its coverage between Gauteng and the KwaZulu-Natal coast.

Customers can choose from residential, commercial or heat pump solutions depending on the type of property and equipment involved, and the company also offers servicing for existing air conditioning systems rather than only new installations. EZAIR holds a 4.5-star Google rating from around 50 reviews, with customers describing the business as helpful, professional and reliable for ongoing maintenance of previously troublesome air conditioning systems.

Gamazine Paint manufactures and applies its own decorative plaster-finish coating from premises in East Lynne, Pretoria. The product, marketed under the Gamazine name, is a custom-mixed blend of crushed marble, sand and quartz stone chips, giving walls a textured, stone-like finish rather than the flat look of ordinary paint.

The company both supplies the coating and sends its own teams to apply it, delivering and installing the finish on walls across South Africa rather than limiting its work to the local Pretoria area. It markets the coating on durability, saying a properly applied Gamazine finish can last up to 20 years without needing to be repainted, a point aimed at homeowners and businesses looking to avoid repeat paint jobs on exterior and feature walls.
